common:

Screenshots: tools/godot_shot.sh OUT.png [--demo=...] [--tab=...] --lang=ru --shot-delay=3 (demos: commanders[:card|tab|locked], shop, royal, pass, calendar, calendar:pick, inbox, profile, dip2, ultimatum, peace_offer, ftue:1, expansion_d10, …; grep the demo list in main.gd); read every PNG you make; crop and zoom (python PIL) to judge edges at real size. steps.title: Portrait follow-ups in the UI files
steps.instructions:
Do every item; verify each in the code first and adapt if the note is wrong (say so):
1. Mipmaps on direct portrait TextureRects. ui_kit.gd `_card_rect()` after `t.texture = tex`: `if tex != null and tex.resource_path.begins_with("res://assets/ui/portraits/"): t.texture_filter = CanvasItem.TEXTURE_FILTER_LINEAR_WITH_MIPMAPS` (covers shop reveal, pass reward, chapter legacy tile). game_ui.gd `_coach_bust_frame()` after `pic.texture = tex`: the same filter (the 160×184 advisor shows stair-stepped hair edges).
2. Reward tiles in the player's era: shop_ui.gd `_reward_look()` (replace the raw `load(p)` with `GameUI.CmdPortrait._render(cmd)`, fall back to icon "shard"), game_ui.gd `_pass_look_rw()` (same with `CmdPortrait._render(String(rw[1]))`), main.gd `_grant_legacy()` (same; `ct["icon_side"] = 100.0`). Then put commander rewards on their rarity plate (Kit.RARITY, plate B look of cmd_portrait — reuse CmdPortrait as the tile art when it fits the bake, otherwise a plate behind the texture); the raw render now fills only ~55 % of the 87×100 tile — the head must read at 48–52 px.
3. Inbox advisor mood: game_ui.gd `_inbox_row()` sets mood on the KitStill wrapper, so the advisor is calm. Give `_cmd_face()` a `mood := ""` parameter (set `p.mood` before `_still_portrait(p)`) and call it with "smile" there.
4. Diplomacy card: `_diplomacy_card()` `_leader_bust(it, Rect2(22, -14, 128, 147))` → about `Rect2(40, -8, 92, 106)` so the state name no longer covers the mouth and Mirosya's curls are not clipped; check all 10 leaders in dip2 / the diplomacy tab.
5. Ruler crown margin: game_ui.gd `show_profile()` and hud.gd `_build_crest()` centre the 256×294 ruler with KEEP_ASPECT_COVERED, the crown is 3–5 px from the well top. Top-anchored cover (`STRETCH_SCALE`, size = (w, w × 294/256), y = 0) → ~11 px profile / ~8 px HUD.
6. HUD crest sky: hud.gd `_build_crest()` `sky.texture = Kit.vgradient(Kit.SKY_TOP, Kit.SKY_LOW)` makes the ruler's rim melt (41 %). Use `Kit.vgradient(Kit.SKY_TOP.lightened(0.18), Kit.SKY_TOP)` (rim 29–34 % in E1–E4, passes ≥ 25 %) and update the «Плита» line in docs/art_direction.md §7.10 to the colours you ship; measure the rim contrast yourself in all 4 eras (tools/qa_portraits has the rim tool — read its usage).
7. Fan busts follow the era: game_ui.gd `_commanders_card()`: after `pics[slot[r]] = CmdPortrait.new(...)` add the node to group "kit_era" so `set_portrait_era` redraws it at once.
8. Toasts over modal titles: the chronicle toast («Летопись: …») lands on the open album window's title banner (DL6/DL8). In `_toast_y()` / `_toast_build`: while a modal window is open, place toasts below that window's title banner (or at the bottom safe area above the tray) so no title is ever covered; keep the queue/merge behaviour; check with the commanders album open and a chronicle toast, and with shop/pass/calendar open.
9. Docs: in docs/art_direction.md §7.12 mark the shipped «Следом» items as done (one line each with the function names); leave face crops and hero chests for step T2.
Verify: BEFORE and AFTER screenshots of every place you touch (royal reveal, pass, chapter legacy tile/expansion_d10, ftue:1 advisor, inbox, dip2 + diplomacy tab, profile, HUD crest E1–E4 (--dl / era demos), commanders:tab with an era change, a toast over the album); zoomed crops; canvas draw counts before/after per screen; tests, ui_lint, check_strings.
steps.verify: before/after pairs + crops in scratch tails/T1_portrait_ui; draw counts table; test_flow PASS, 0 SCRIPT ERROR; lint + strings clean

steps.title: Face crops for slots ≤ 72 px and 256 px hero chests
steps.instructions:
Two parts (docs/art_direction.md §7.12 «Не отгружаются», §7.13 «Выход», §7.15 п.4).
A. Face crops. Slots ≤ 72 px (commander picker 72, inbox/calendar 64, «Армия» fan 58×70, army chip Ø38 — table §7.12) show the whole bust, so the head is 27–40 px. `tools/blender/portrait_assets.py --frame=face` renders a square face frame (+31 % head at 64 px). Render face crops for the files those slots actually use (find them in game_ui.gd / hud.gd / cmd_portrait.gd: probably the 12 commanders × 4 eras calm, maybe smile — decide from the code, do not render what no slot shows), at 256×256 (they are drawn at ≤ 72 px; mipmaps on), names `face_<base name>.png` in game/assets/ui/portraits, RGBA transparent, same light/style as the busts. Renders are slow (≈45–60 s per frame on 4 cores, another agent renders in Blender too) — render in one background batch, check a sheet early on 3 files before the full batch. Run the portrait QA that applies (framing/contrast/eras tools in tools/qa_portraits; add a face-frame mode if a check assumes the bust frame). In cmd_portrait.gd: when the node's drawn size is ≤ 72 px and a face file exists for the same era/mood chain, use it (keep the fallback chain and the API; locked silhouette and plate/halo still apply; era cache purge covers the new files). Check the git .gitignore rule for portraits/*.import (a negation exists for cmd_*.png.import — add one for face_*.png.import) and set mipmaps/generate=true in their imports.
B. Hero chests 256 px. The chest masters 256 px from C1 are kept in the scratchpad (find them: grep icon_assets.py for where it saves masters; if lost, re-render with icon_assets.py at 256 without the 128 downscale but with the INK rim scaled). Ship hero versions `chest_wood_hero.png`, `chest_silver_hero.png`, `chest_royal_hero.png` (+ chest_cards if the opening uses it) into game/assets/ui/icons (mipmaps on), and use them only where a chest is drawn larger than ~110 px: the shop chest tiles and the chest opening / royal reveal (shop_ui.gd). They are drawn outside the KitBake icon atlas (a TextureRect with mipmaps), so measure the canvas draw count on shop and royal before/after (≤ +2 each); everywhere else the 128 atlas icons stay.
Verify: before/after screenshots of every slot ≤ 72 px (commander picker, inbox, calendar, calendar:pick, commanders:tab fan, a map army chip at strat/mid zoom) and of shop + royal reveal + opening; zoomed crops; head-height table (px) before/after; draw counts; test_flow, ui_lint, check_strings; update §7.12/§7.13/§7.15 lines to what shipped.
steps.verify: sheets of face crops; before/after pairs; head-height table; draw counts; tests
